research_question: Can the additive P4-N adapter read one real persisted active typed preference without a caller-supplied reference_time while preserving the same validity instant across its base and additive reads?
single_changed_variable: default reference_time exactly once at the P4-N adapter boundary and pass that same non-null value to both reads

development_case.write_input: 今はごぼう茶が好き。今の飲み物の好みとして覚えといて。
development_case.recall_input: What is my current drink preference?
development_case.expected_surface: 今の飲み物の好みはごぼう茶。前のじゃなくて、今の方ね。

before_expectation.recall_exception_message: reference_time must be an ISO datetime or datetime instance

success_requirements: a real temporary Chroma collection returns the exact frozen Japanese surface when reference_time is omitted
the base P4-J read and additive P4-N re-read receive one identical non-null ISO datetime
an explicit caller-supplied reference_time is passed through byte-for-byte to both reads
a record valid at the explicit reference time remains eligible
a record expired at the explicit reference time remains ineligible and is never surfaced
the read performs no profile mutation and adds no model call
all P4-N provenance script length punctuation and injection abstention boundaries remain unchanged
the P4-M and P4-N-REAL terminal failures remain preserved without rerun
failure_requirements: preserve the exception or any semantic regression as a failed P4-O result
do not change the frozen development case after implementation
do not add the development or exposed product values to the finite localization map
do not rerun the exposed そば茶 product case
do not claim product delivery from offline evidence
